change: Explain measured model-call duration using saved provider timings for the three existing dashboard examples.
tested_revision: Source bytes identified by the SHA-256 values below; exact published commit recorded by Sites.

checks.name: Independent historical source audit
checks.detail: A separate read-only review recovered timing metadata from original requests/checkpoints and matched every provider timing. Coverage 11/11, 5/5 and 16/17; the missing call is the browser example summarization at ordinal 16.

checks.name: Numeric export and missing-data treatment
checks.detail: 33 CSV rows agree with JSON; all component sums match measured call totals. Missing provider durations stay empty in CSV and remain part of unclassified wall time.

checks.name: Frozen source integrity
checks.detail: Every archived source fingerprint matches the read-only audit.

checks.name: Export privacy
checks.detail: No absolute Windows paths, raw model prose/requests, private call IDs or GUIDs in public JSON. Only numeric metadata and tool outcome labels are exported.

checks.name: Browser interaction and visual inspection
checks.detail: All three selector options displayed matching breakdowns. Browser example visibly reports 16/17 metadata coverage and missing-data caveat. Default example shows 31.60 s model total, 32.42 s monitored session and no published card. No console errors; at the available 1265 px viewport document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. Screenshot retained locally.

limitations: Historical diagnosis only; no new model benchmark or demonstrated latency improvement.
Only the monitor example records full session telemetry; session excludes process startup/preflight and browser delivery.
Checkpoint and monitor I/O were not separately instrumented; residual time is not checkpoint time.
No real web/source wait, ASR or mobile end-to-end latency was measured.
The cause of the large first-call model load is unknown; no cold/warm comparison was run.
Responsive CSS is retained; this update was visually checked at the available desktop viewport only.
